description: Resolves a public IP address to the PTR hostnames published for it, or returns the resolver's error where there is none. A PTR is set by whoever controls the address block, so it names the host rather than necessarily the site; a missing PTR is common and not a fault. Forward and reverse records need not agree, and this call does not check that they do. Anonymous, rate-limited per IP.
name: reverse_dns
title: Reverse DNS
